title: China border 'more alive,' India enhancing frontier infra: Jaishankar
description:
India's border with China has become "more alive" and requires a much greater commitment of Indian troops on a sustained basis, External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar said on Saturday as he listed New Delhi's policy approach to enhance infrastructure along the frontier.
Jaishankar also said that India has bolstered its military capabilities along the Line of Actual Control (LAC)  since the deadly clashes in Eastern Ladakh's Galwan Valley in 2020.
His remarks at an interactive session at the HT Leadership Summit came amid ongoing efforts by New Delhi and Beijing to normalise their relations that came under severe strain following the over four-year border face-off in Eastern Ladakh.
"Just think about the last few years. How often do you now read - a new tunnel has been built, some new bridge has been built, another airfield has been commissioned.  You're getting this news with greater and greater frequency," he said.
